collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager has a bright red sunburnt nose and a friend brings a green remedy: accept it, or pretend nothing is wrong.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) fell asleep on the beach yesterday afternoon with (subject.his/her) face turned to the sun. Today (subject.his/her) nose is bright red. It glows. People keep looking at it and then very deliberately not looking at it. (friend) arrives with a bowl of something green and a very straight face.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Thank you," says (subject), "but I'm fine." (subject.He/she) goes about (subject.his/her) day with great dignity and a glowing nose. (child), a child, asks if it hurts. (grownup), a grown-up, asks if (subject.he/she) fell asleep on the beach. By midday (subject) has quietly gone back and asked for the green stuff.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "For the nose," says (friend). It's crushed leaves and something cool. (subject) smears it on. Now (subject.his/her) nose is bright red underneath and bright green on top. Everybody stops pretending not to look. (subject) gives up and laughs. The nose feels much better by evening. It still glows a little.
